verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe self-hosting the core product: it is a single binary with no external dependencies that runs on Linux, macOS, or Windows, on bare metal or in containers. The docs cover install paths via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or source, official Docker images and Helm charts, and production guidance (reverse proxy, systemd, master key). Independent users corroborate production self-hosting on Hetzner machines, k8s clusters, and one-click Coolify Docker installs, including large-scale deployments of up to 80M documents.
